Worker crate gains status-ownership types (InternalCodingAgentWorkflowPlan, ScheduledParityDriftCanaryPlan, ParityCanaryStatusState, ParityCanaryStatusSpec) with Fable-first default profile naming (dogfood-fable-runtime); adapter enums stay adapter-agnostic (claude|codex|gemini).

facets.F10_reversibility: All changes are additive code/contract/evidence edits on an isolated worktree branch (agent/ci-canary-status-surfaces); plain git revert restores prior state; no live cluster, migration, or data mutation.
facets.F11_observability: Adds read-only redacted status surfaces (REST/proto/AsyncAPI) for agent runtimes, schedules, and parity canaries, plus an honest policy-engine readiness probe that degrades reported gateway status under default-deny.
facets.F13_migration: Closes the #663-vs-#644 parallel-lane gap by re-deriving the stranded subset against the ADR-0550 seam shapes (workers -> oya-cloud-intelligence-worker) so #663 can be closed without capability loss.

hyperscaler_lens: Control-plane status read surfaces follow the K8s status-subresource pattern: controllers own execution, the API serves redacted resource-ref status with sealed evidence handles and Retry-After semantics; no CLI/TUI surface, console+API only.
explicit_non_claims: No production deployment, live cluster apply, or runtime rollout was executed from this branch.
No reviewer approval or remote protected-branch CI result is claimed before PR submission.
The status payloads are contract-shaped first-cut projections (single dogfood profile rows), not yet wired to live controller state stores.
No direct core ownership of transient external policy or secret engines is claimed; owned adapter ports remain the boundary.
known_gaps: Remote cloud-ci/protected-branch contexts and reviewer approval remain PR-governance follow-up after push.
proto RPCs are contract-first; a gRPC server binding for the three status RPCs lands with the service's gRPC adapter work.
AsyncAPI publish operations are contract-first; worker emission wiring to the Pulsar channels is follow-up controller work.
